prompt:
You are writing short, natural English messages for a WhatsApp group chat.
Group members (use only these names as senders): Divya ji, Tanuja ji, Sunil C., Sunil ji.
Topic: everyday small talk, money lending, meeting up. Never mention deleting or removing any record,
entry, transfer or transaction. Use no digits, amounts, dates, month or weekday names, web
addresses, real bank, app or company names, and no instructions such as send, pay or transfer.
For each section below, write exactly as many messages as stated, in time order:
- between 7:15 pm and 8:08 pm: 12 messages
- between 8:08 pm and 9:15 pm: 13 messages
Reply with only a JSON list and no other text: [{"time": "9:02 pm", "sender": "NAME", "text": "message"}, ...]
Each "time" must look like "h:mm am" or "h:mm pm". Each message must be one line.
text:
[
  {"time": "7:18 pm", "sender": "Divya ji", "text": "Good evening everyone, how was your day?"},
  {"time": "7:22 pm", "sender": "Tanuja ji", "text": "Good evening! Just finished dinner preparations."},
  {"time": "7:26 pm", "sender": "Sunil C.", "text": "Hey all, traffic was terrible on the main road earlier."},
  {"time": "7:31 pm", "sender": "Sunil ji", "text": "Same here, just reached home."},
  {"time": "7:35 pm", "sender": "Divya ji", "text": "Sunil ji, did you manage to get that cash assistance we talked about?"},
  {"time": "7:40 pm", "sender": "Sunil ji", "text": "Yes, I managed to arrange some cash earlier."},
  {"time": "7:44 pm", "sender": "Tanuja ji", "text": "That is great. We should meet up for coffee soon."},
  {"time": "7:49 pm", "sender": "Sunil C.", "text": "Count me in for coffee. Are we meeting near the park?"},
  {"time": "7:53 pm", "sender": "Divya ji", "text": "The park cafe sounds nice."},
  {"time": "7:58 pm", "sender": "Sunil ji", "text": "I still owe you for that previous loan, Divya ji."},
  {"time": "8:02 pm", "sender": "Divya ji", "text": "No rush at all, keep it as long as you need."},
  {"time": "8:06 pm", "sender": "Tanuja ji", "text": "You two are always so helpful to each other."},
  {"time": "8:12 pm", "sender": "Sunil C.", "text": "Are we bringing families to the meetup?"},
  {"time": "8:17 pm", "sender": "Tanuja ji", "text": "Yes, that would be wonderful."},
  {"time": "8:22 pm", "sender": "Divya ji", "text": "Also, Tanuja ji, did you receive the cash I handed over earlier?"},

  {"time": "8:31 pm", "sender": "Sunil ji", "text": "Glad that worked out for everyone."},
  {"time": "8:36 pm", "sender": "Sunil C.", "text": "By the way, is the market open late tonight?"},
  {"time": "8:40 pm", "sender": "Divya ji", "text": "I think shops close quite early."},
  {"time": "8:45 pm", "sender": "Tanuja ji", "text": "Let us meet later this evening at the usual place if possible."},
  {"time": "8:50 pm", "sender": "Sunil ji", "text": "Sounds good to me, I will bring the borrowed cash to return to you."},
  {"time": "8:55 pm", "sender": "Divya ji", "text": "Wonderful, we can settle our accounts over tea."},
  {"time": "9:01 pm", "sender": "Sunil C.", "text": "Perfect, I will see you all there shortly."},
  {"time": "9:07 pm", "sender": "Tanuja ji", "text": "See you all soon!"},
  {"time": "9:12 pm", "sender": "Sunil ji", "text": "Reaching in a few minutes."}
]
